children: Wolters Kluwer N.V. (EURONEXT:WKL) is executing a €500M buyback—€2.5M repurchased Aug 20–26 and €256M via third party with shares held for cancellation—while upgrading Health Language for U.S. payers and, with Dentsu Soken, deploying CCH Tagetik for Daihatsu.
: Wolters Kluwer (WKL) repurchased 35,866 shares Aug 20–26 for €2.5M at €68.66 avg, part of a 2026 €500M buyback; €256M executed via third party, shares held as treasury for cancellation
: Wolters Kluwer (WKL) updated Health Language tools for U.S. payers: improved terminology mapping, value set management, new crosswalks and codes to align EHR terms with payer CPT/ICD-10-CM/HCPCS.
: Wolters Kluwer (WKL) and Dentsu Soken won Daihatsu contract to deploy CCH Tagetik for centralized budget, forecasting and revisions, with phased rollout, spreadsheet UI and ongoing managed support.
